name: Pork Chops with Blackberry Sauce & Lemon Arugula Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Season pork generously with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, bone-in
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Place pork on grill/skillet and cook until cooked through, 4-6 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Heat a small saucepan over medium heat.

Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add blackberries, vinegar, honey, and salt. Reduce heat to medium-low and, stirring occasionally, cook until sauce thickens and some of the berries collapse, 10-12 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 ½ tbsp honey
⅜ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Grate 3 tsp of lemon zest. In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together lemon zest and juice, olive oil, honey, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
zest and juice of 1 ½ lemon
4 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinches salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry arugula. Add to bowl with dressing and toss to coat.
Shave or grate ⅓ cup of Parmesan.
To serve, place pork chops on a plate and spoon blackberry sauce over top. Add salad on the side and garnish with Parmesan and pine nuts. Enjoy!
